Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University Startup Cell 7 Supporting agencies and policy links 25 Startup profiles listed in old source 56 Events and activities archived STARTUP CELL Overview Startup Cell of Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara, Gujarat is actively engaged in harnessing the entrepreneurial potential of startups by providing end to end support through seed funds, access to infrastructure in terms of co-working space and access to lab facilities comprising sophisticated equipment along with mentoring and networking platforms for start-ups by community building with wide range of the industry mentors, investors, government stakeholders and entrepreneurs. Startup Cell acts as a collaborative platform that helps transform early-stage startups into business ventures that make significant economic and social impact. Through startup competitions, pitch events, and accelerator programs, the Startup Cell not only supports the growth of emerging startups but also promotes a culture of innovation in students, positioning the university as a key player in the entrepreneurial ecosystem. ENTREPRENEURSHIP ECOSYSTEM Centre Focus 1 The Krishna Centre of Excellence in Startup and Entrepreneurship is dedicated to support and fulfill the dreams of enthusiastic innovators to become successful entrepreneurs and also to contribute in the mission to step ahead in the direction of Aatmnirbhar Bharat. 2 The goal of Krishna Centre of Excellence in Startup and Entrepreneurship is creation of a vibrant start-up culture where ideas materialize into products, entrepreneurs are mentored, businesses are incubated and product or process innovation is facilitated to become business of global scale to contribute to economic prosperity of the nation and for generation of employment. 3 The policy of the centre encourages the creation of innovation pipelines and pathways for entrepreneurs at university level by sufficient resource mobilization and utilization of pre-incubation and incubation facilities for nurturing innovations and startups of students, startups and faculty members. 4 Another major function of the center is facilitating registration and licensing of intellectual property of innovators and startups to safeguard their intellectual creations and IP monetization. 5 Promotion and development of entrepreneurship is one of the major dimensions of the university strategy and is implemented through value added programs such as conferences, workshops, mentoring sessions, innovation competitions, hackathons etc. 6 The accomplishment of the product to market strategy for startups through the development of entrepreneurship culture is not only limited within the boundaries of the university as the strategy is well supported through collaboration with government agencies and industries. NETWORKS AND APPROVALS Supporting Agencies Industries Commissionerate Government of Gujarat Krishna School of Emerging Technologies & Applied Research received approval as NODAL INSTITUTE under Scheme for Assistance to Startups/Innovation 2020. Center Entrepreneurship Development Government Of Gujarat Krishna School of Emerging Technologies Applied Research established Entrepreneurship Development Cell in collaboration. Wadhawani Foundation National Entrepreneurship Network Krishna School of Emerging Technologies & Applied Research has signed MOU with Wadhawani Foundation National Entrepreneurship Network, to accelerate entrepreneurship, innovation and skills development among students. Centre for Entrepreneurship Technology Incubation and Business Acceleration Krishna School of Emerging Technologies & Applied Research has established Centre for Entrepreneurship, Technology Incubation and Business Acceleration (CETIBA), an incubation centre to enable start-ups with an efficient mentoring program, relevant training and a convenient co-working hub. The centre is approved by Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprise, Government of India. Student Startup & Innovation Policy KPGU, Vadodara has signed MOU with Gujarat Knowledge Society, Govt. of Gujarat under Student Startup & Innovation Policy (SSIP) 2.0 and financial support of Rs 20 lacs per year for five years has been sanctioned to KPGU Vadodara for conducting innovation, startup and IPR activities. Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology Krishna Educational Foundation promoted by KPGU, Vadodara was selected as Incubation Centre for implementation of the scheme titled "Gen-Next Support for Innovative Startups (GENESIS)" of Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). Startup India Seed Fund Startup India Seed Fund of 3 Cr. granted to incubator Krishna Educational Foundation promoted by KPGU, Vadodara for the purpose of supporting startups.
